title: Happy squirrel
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='55' rx='17' ry='28' fill='#c0682a' transform='rotate(-25 28 55)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='55' rx='11' ry='21' fill='#e09050' transform='rotate(-25 28 55)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='19' fill='#e09050'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#ffe0b0'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='86' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#c0682a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='86' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#c0682a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='19' fill='#e09050'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='24' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#c0682a' transform='rotate(-15 38 24)'/>

  <ellipse cx='62' cy='25' rx='2.5' ry='4.5' fill='#ffd0a0' transform='rotate(15 62 25)'/>

  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a08'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a08'/>

  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='2.2' fill='#8a3a10'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 49 Q50 54 56 49' stroke='#8a3a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#c0682a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='62' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#c0682a'/>
  <!-- acorn -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#c08040'/>
  <path d='M45 58 Q50 54 55 58 Q50 60 45 58' fill='#8a5020'/>
